The radar team at Met Éireann have assessed sites across the country and shortlisted three sites in each region, which meet their requirements. Met Éireann, a line Division of the Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage (DHLGH), is the National Meteorological Service of Ireland. Met Éireann owns and operates the national weather radar network, which currently consists of two weather radars, one located at Dublin Airport and one at Shannon Airport. Following an assessment of the spatial coverage and suitability of the current national weather radar network and of future requirements for the network, Met Éireann commenced a project to install four new weather radars at strategic locations around the country.
